paragraph: I build enterprise-grade systems and immersive 3D web experiences. Currently at NTT DATA, I work on the Unified Volunteers Platform for the United Nations Volunteers — .NET microservices, clean architecture, and Azure serving a global user base. My work lives at the intersection of scalable backends, real-time 3D on the web, and AI-assisted automation already running in production.
